name: Charmian
summary: Charmian, also known as α-methyl-DOM, α,α,4-trimethyl-2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, or BL-4041A, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, phentermine, and DOx families related to DOM. It is the α-methyl derivative of DOM or the 4-methyl-2,5-dimethoxy derivative of phentermine.

pharmacology.text: Charmian, also known as α-methyl-DOM, α,α,4-trimethyl-2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, or BL-4041A, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, phentermine, and DOx families related to DOM.

uses.text: According to Alexander Shulgin in his book PiHKAL (Phenethylamines I Have Known and Loved), Charmian was synthesized and studied and was found to be of greatly reduced affinity for serotonin receptors and potency in animals compared to DOM.

fact.en: Charmian is DOM with a second methyl group on the carbon next to its nitrogen, making it the DOM version of the diet drug phentermine. That one extra methyl greatly weakens its binding to serotonin receptors.
fact.zh: Charmian 是在 DOM 靠近氮原子的碳上再多接一個甲基，相當於減肥藥芬特明的 DOM 版本。就是這一個額外的甲基，讓它與血清素受體的結合大幅減弱。
fact.zhHans: Charmian 是在 DOM 靠近氮原子的碳上再多接一个甲基，相当于减肥药芬特明的 DOM 版本。就是这一个额外的甲基，让它与血清素受体的结合大幅减弱。
